quarterly_data.quarter: Renesas press release: Renesas to Phase Out Production at Takasaki Factory; (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Production at the Takasaki Factory (6-inch wafer line, operated by subsidiary Renesas Semiconductor Manufacturing) will be discontinued within the next two to three years, with the closure of the factory to follow; Renesas will assess customer demand and build up the necessary inventory beforehand. The site's R&D functions, mainly analog ICs and discrete power semiconductors, will be repositioned to support development of analog ICs and power semiconductors for data center and automotive applications (strategic focus areas). The timing of the production discontinuation and the R&D details have not yet been determined.
quarterly_data.figure: Takasaki production discontinued within the next two to three years
